template.title: Layout
template.help: Pick a template for preview and PDF export. Changes apply to all CVs.

classic.label: Classic

modern.label: Modern
modern.description: Left-aligned with navy accents. Great for tech, product, and startup roles.

sidebar.label: Sidebar
sidebar.description: Two-column layout with contact and skills in a dark sidebar.

executive.label: Executive

backup.title: Backup & restore
backup.description: Save local snapshots inside the app, restore them later, or download a JSON backup file when you need a copy elsewhere.
backup.snapshotHelp: Snapshots stay on this device. Use Download when you want to save a copy to another folder.
backup.noSnapshots: No snapshots yet. Create one to keep a restore point before big changes.
backup.confirmDeleteSnapshot: Delete this snapshot? This cannot be undone.
backup.mergeHelp: Merge adds records from the backup that do not already exist. Existing records are kept.
backup.replaceHelp: Replace deletes all local data first, then restores the backup exactly.
backup.confirmReplace: Replace all local data with this backup? This cannot be undone.

cloud.title: Cloud backup (S3 / MinIO)
cloud.description: Upload snapshots to an S3-compatible bucket on your network (for example MinIO on a NAS). Prefill from apps/web/.env; access and secret keys are password fields and are never written into backup files.
cloud.descriptionServer: Upload and restore backups through the gateway. MinIO connection settings are configured on the server via environment variables — not in this browser UI.
cloud.desktopOnly: Cloud backup needs the desktop app or the CV Tailor gateway.
cloud.runtimeRequired: Cloud backup needs the desktop app or the CV Tailor gateway.
cloud.empty: No remote backups yet. Upload one to share data with another device.
cloud.incomplete: Fill in endpoint, bucket, access key, and secret key first.
cloud.help: Prefills from apps/web/.env (VITE_CLOUD_BACKUP_*). Access and secret keys use password fields. Secrets are not included in uploaded JSON and must not be committed.
